message: Astra: In this revision, you added a seasonal list, repeated the seasonal overview, and finally returned to the budding tree; does that sequence create the passage of time you want, or delay the moment you chose? Where does the reader most need your attention now? Would another round of thinking about pacing reveal something the existing versions cannot, or would a revision give more useful evidence? Conversely, what uncertainty about the time this notebook scene covers deserves resolving before you draft? What evidence would justify your choice, and could you carry out your chosen next step?
